biotools.summary: BindFlow is a free, open-source Python pipeline for automated absolute binding free energy (ABFE) calculations using FEP or MM(PB/GB)SA, built on the GROMACS MD engine with built-in support for GAFF, OpenFF, Espaloma, and custom small-molecule force fields.
